items.headline: Value Creed launches RADAR analytics tool
items.summary: Value Creed introduced RADAR, a new tool aimed at converting the large data volumes held in E/CTRM, ERP and market systems into actionable trading intelligence, according to CTRM Center.

items.headline: BRAC Bank rolls out digital trade finance platform
items.summary: Bangladesh's BRAC Bank launched a new digital trade finance platform built with Finastra's Trade Innovation and Corporate Channels plus Conpend's Trade AI technology, unifying previously fragmented corporate trade workflows.

items.headline: Red Sea container traffic edges toward full return
items.summary: Freightos reports more container vessels are returning to the Red Sea despite continued Houthi attack risk, with a full normalization of transit expected by Q1, even as oil prices hover near $100/bbl.

items.headline: EMIR REFIT shifts focus to data quality
items.summary: With EMIR REFIT go-live now complete, EU supervisors are pressing firms to prove derivatives reports are accurate and well-controlled, not just technically accepted by trade repositories, per EIMF.
